messages:
Maya: Hey folks — two quick festive things: 1) I'm compiling a 'Redwood Jingle Jam' playlist for the holidays, drop your must-have song links/short recs. 2) Also launching a totally optional (and very low-stakes) gingerbread house showcase. Post pics, we vote by reactions, winner gets a mystery mug from the office kitchen. :tada: 

Devon: Love this. Adding 'Last Christmas' (classic chaos). Also do we accept pre-built kits? Asking for a friend. :grimacing: 

Priya: Adding some Bhangra remixes and Sia's holiday song. Pre-built kits absolutely allowed — creativity counts more than structural integrity. :cookie: 

Liam: Here's a good tempo playlist starter: <https://open.spotify.com/track/6habFhsOp2NvshLv26DqMb?si=holiday-starter>. Also in for photos later. 

Nora: I'm bringing my terrible icing skills. Count me in for the contest. Will probably enter a 'leaning tower' theme. :house_with_garden: :laughing: 

Jules: Quick poll idea — vote by reactions: :star: = best song suggestion, :house: = gingerbread entry, :coffee: = both. Cool? 

Maya: Love it. I'll drop the playlist after lunch and pin it. For the contest, post pics in thread by end of next Friday. Voting runs the following Monday. 

Sam: GIF: <https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-bake-gingerbread-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40> 

Priya: Photo: (uploaded) "attempt_gingerbread_v1.jpg" — built from kit, very proud. :sweat_smile: 

Devon: Photo: (uploaded) "devon_gb_house_final.jpg" — improvised snow bank using marshmallows. Will accept donations of structural support. :snowflake: 

Liam: Photo: (uploaded) "liam_ginger_tower.jpg" — sideways but festive. :party_parrot: 

Maya: Playlist link pinned: <https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0AholidayRedwood> — add away. Also added Jules' reaction poll. 

holiday-bot: Reminder: "Holiday photo submissions close in 6 days at 17:00 PST." 

Nora: Quick logistics Q — can I leave my mug prize on the front desk shelf if I win? I'll grab it next week. 

Maya: Yes — we'll put it in 'Gifts for winners' with a sticky note. 

Jules: Reaction check-in: star=5, house=3, coffee=2 so far. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Sam: Adding 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' (duh) and 'Fairytale of New York' for vibes. 

Devon: Also proposing a 30-min gingerbread drop-in on Thursday where we can assemble together on Zoom. Who's in? :call_me_hand: 

Priya: In for the drop-in! Might do a royal icing demo (or a chaotic approximation). :woman_baking: 

Liam: In. Will bring extra marshmallows for Devon's structural experiments. 

Nora: Can't make the drop-in but will watch the highlights. Good luck, everyone. :four_leaf_clover:

Maya: Amazing. This is exactly the kind of low-pressure nonsense I like. Will post final rules and the exact voting emoji map tomorrow. Also — feel free to throw in non-holiday playlists if you want a mix. :sparkles: 

holiday-bot: "Pinned: Redwood Jingle Jam playlist"

Jules: Also offering a consolation prize: one packet of office fancy tea to the most creative entry (runner-up). :tea: 

Maya: Official thread sign-off for now — thanks for the fast responses. Expect pin + rules tomorrow. :heart:
